title: Make OpenCode ACP config test synchronization deterministic
outcome: Required scripts/test-rust.sh gate failed under the normal four-thread full suite at tests::opencode_config::opencode_session_new_reapplies_explicit_model_effort_then_mode_before_ready: take_pending_acp_request exhausted its fixed 1-second polling deadline ('ACP request should arrive before timeout'). The exact test immediately passed in isolation in 0.11 seconds. Classify as a test defect caused by load-sensitive polling/thread scheduling, not a product failure and not 'flaky'. Replace the arbitrary polling deadline with deterministic request publication synchronization or a suite-budgeted helper that reports which protocol stage timed out; retain ordering assertions and prove stability under the full Rust wrapper.
